family.en:
Good evening from Alkyoni Suites!
Tomorrow, Monday 9 November:
18°, light wind from the E, sea north small waves, west small waves, south calm.

2. Botanical Park of Crete · 11:00–14:00

3. Theriso village & gorge drive · 13:00–16:00

All picks, maps and directions: https://firmusagency.github.io/weather-mood/guest.html
Have a good evening! If the weather changes, we will let you know in the morning.
